description: Estimate the monthly rent Lentra would pay the building under the Fixed Rent model for a configuration. An indication, not a quote. Nothing is saved.

country.description: Country of the building (ISO code). Needed for the rent indication.

modules.description: Add-on modules beside the core hub, any combination: fridge = Beverage fridge (Chilled drinks, on demand), freezer = Ice-cream freezer (Frozen treats around the clock), tech = Electronics (Chargers, cables and accessories), wellness = Premium wellness (Recovery and self-care items), pet = Pet section (Treats, toys and pet essentials), baby = Baby section (Wipes, diapers and necessities).

size.description: s = Medium, 3 m, 12 compartments, best for 60–100 units. m = Large, 5 m, 20 compartments, best for 150+ units.

term.description: y1 = One year, then rolling. y2 = Two years, then rolling (pays 20% more rent for the whole time installed).

name: estimate_rent
title: Estimate Fixed Rent
